hero.name: Melanie Arenas
hero.role: Business Analytics & AI student at UT Dallas
hero.intro: I build AI agents and data-driven tools, from a real-time scam call detector at HackUTD 2026 to a personal workflow agent. I'm ready to take everything I've learned and grow into something bigger.

about.title: About Me
paragraphs: I'm a native of the **South Side of Chicago**, now studying **Business Analytics and AI** at The University of Texas at Dallas. I've always been the person who wants to know *why* the numbers look the way they do. To me, **data tells a story**, and I love finding it, cleaning it up, and turning it into something people can actually use.

My goal is to **build financial apps** that make money easier to understand and manage, especially for people who've never had the right tools. I also love **presenting and teaching**. Some of my favorite moments are walking my friends and classmates through a new idea and watching it click.

Before tech, I spent **5 years in insurance and sales**, which taught me how to listen, explain complex things simply, and solve problems for real people. Looking back, I've grown so much on this journey, and **I can't wait to see what's next**.
about.note: Eligible to work in the US for internships and full-time with no restrictions.

items.title: Safe Signal: AI-Powered Live Scam Call Detection
points: Built a real-time scam call protection tool in 24 hours that analyzes the caller's voice to detect AI-generated speech and scans the conversation for scam language patterns within the first seconds of a call.

Designed an AI agent using NVIDIA Nemotron that verifies caller identity and number reputation, plus a one-tap flow that lowers the caller's volume, privately warns the user, and blocks and reports the number.
Created a synthetic dataset of scam and legitimate calls for testing and applied privacy-by-design principles by analyzing calls without storing recordings.

items.title: Scan & Personalize: AI-Powered Beauty Discovery at Sephora
points: Co-designed an AI-powered in-store scanning concept linking customer app profiles with personalized product recommendations across 2,000+ SKUs.
Built a business case and financial model projecting 35% higher conversion, 40% fewer returns, and a $3.85M first-year net gain against a $1.7M investment.
Mapped the customer journey and proposed a six-month rollout covering AI model development, pilot testing, and national launch.

items.title: Personal AI Agent for Workflow Efficiency
